# Plan: Mamba/Attention/Router/Shared-Expert Offloading for Nemotron-H on 12GB GPU

## 1. Technical Analysis & Tensor Mapping

The Nemotron-H architecture (loaded in `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`) exhibits a **hybrid MoE/Mamba/Attention** structure. To fit within a 12GB GPU constraint while allowing overflow to CPU RAM, we must selectively offload specific tensor groups. The following analysis maps exact tensor names and sizes to the GPU memory budget.

### A. Tensors Safe for GPU (Low Overhead / High Reuse)
These tensors are small, frequently reused, or essential for the core attention path. They should remain on GPU.

| Tensor Name | Shape | Size (FP16) | Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tok_embd` | `{n_embd, n_vocab}` | ~2GB+ | Large embedding table; offloading yields minimal savings for standard generation but is required if `n_vocab` is massive. Kept on GPU for token embedding lookups. |
| `output_norm` | `{n_embd}` | ~4KB | Negligible size. |
| `output` / `output_dup` | `{n_embd, n_vocab}` | ~2GB | Output projection. Offloading is possible but embedding lookup is fast; kept on GPU for latency. |
| `layer.attn_norm` | `{n_embd}` | ~4KB per layer | RMSNorm weights. Essential for attention; kept on GPU. |
| `layer.wo` | `{n_embd_head_k * n_head_i, n_embd}` | ~2MB per layer | Attention output projection. Kept on GPU. |
| `layer.ssm_norm` | `{d_inner / n_group, n_group}` | ~0.5MB per layer | Mamba normalization. Kept on GPU. |
| `layer.ssm_a`, `layer.ssm_d` | `{1, n_ssm_head}` | ~2KB per layer | Mamba state matrices. Kept on GPU. |

### B. Tensors Targeted for CPU RAM Offloading (High Memory / Infrequent Access)
These tensors constitute the bulk of the MoE and Mamba weights. They can be offloaded to CPU RAM, loaded on-demand during the forward pass, and swapped
